articles.title: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
articles.snippet: The Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act would ease complicated tax burdens for everyday use of cryptocurrencies, though Trump's industry ties spurred some pushback.

articles.title: Revolut ID thefts highlight KYC’s dangers: Here’s how to fix it
articles.snippet: Zero-knowledge technology could let companies verify who you are without storing your identity documents. So why isn’t it already standard practice?

articles.title: Bernstein expects ‘aggressive’ rulemaking from SEC, CFTC, following CLARITY Act failure
articles.snippet: Bernstein said the federal agencies will publish new regulations to compensate for the time lost negotiating the CLARITY Act, after its cloture vote failed on Tuesday.

articles.title: Crypto stocks slide after CLARITY Act fails to advance in Senate
articles.snippet: Circle and Coinbase shares fell about 10% as the failed Senate vote weighed on crypto-linked equities, with Bitcoin miners and treasury companies also declining.

articles.title: Zuckerberg Pushes Back on Coordinated AI Slowdown, Says Labs Can Act Alone
articles.snippet: Meta’s CEO says competition and potential liability give AI developers reasons to prioritize safety, citing the company’s decision to delay Muse.
